Description

The Boston University Presidential Scholarship is available to first-year students from around the globe who demonstrate exceptional academic achievement. In addition to being among the most talented students, they also excel beyond the classroom and are leaders in their schools and communities. All students are considered for the Presidential Scholarship: U.S. citizens, permanent residents, eligible non-citizens, and international students. This scholarship covers half tuition. Please visit the scholarship's website for more information.

Eligibility Requirements

  • Must be an undergraduate student
  • Must attend a university
  • Restricted to students studying in Massachusetts
